<think>**Designing one-hot decode**

**Choosing two-level predecode**

</think>

{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);

    wire [3:0] lo;
    wire [3:0] hi;
    wire [9:0] enable;

    assign lo[0] = ~sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo[1] = ~sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign lo[2] =  sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo[3] =  sel[1] &  sel[0];

    assign hi[0] = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2];
    assign hi[1] = ~sel[3] &  sel[2];
    assign hi[2] =  sel[3] & ~sel[2];
    assign hi[3] =  sel[3] &  sel[2];

    assign enable[0] = (hi[0] & lo[0]) |
                       (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign enable[1] = hi[0] & lo[1];
    assign enable[2] = hi[0] & lo[2];
    assign enable[3] = hi[0] & lo[3];
    assign enable[4] = hi[1] & lo[0];
    assign enable[5] = hi[1] & lo[1];
    assign enable[6] = hi[1] & lo[2];
    assign enable[7] = hi[1] & lo[3];
    assign enable[8] = hi[2] & lo[0];
    assign enable[9] = hi[2] & lo[1];

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = ({8{enable[0]}} & block_a) |
                    ({8{enable[1]}} & block_b) |
                    ({8{enable[2]}} & block_c) |
                    ({8{enable[3]}} & block_d) |
                    ({8{enable[4]}} & block_e) |
                    ({8{enable[5]}} & block_f) |
                    ({8{enable[6]}} & block_g) |
                    ({8{enable[7]}} & block_h) |
                    ({8{enable[8]}} & block_i) |
                    ({8{enable[9]}} & block_j);
    end

endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The expected critical structure is select decoding followed by data gating and output reduction. Select-net fanout and buffering may also dominate. The actual baseline critical path is unknown without mapped timing reports.",
  "rewrite": "Use shared two-bit predecoding and an explicit one-hot AND/OR mux. Decode block_a directly for sel=0 and sel=10..15 rather than deriving its enable by detecting that none of the other nine choices matched. This exposes parallel data gating and gives ABC an opportunity to use SKY130HD compound gates.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "An unmeasured hypothesis: direct default decoding may shorten the block_a select path, while parallel gating may reduce maximum arrival. ABC may reconstruct an equivalent baseline topology, so no positive gain or minimum-arrival claim is established. The specified mapping and OpenSTA runs are required.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shared predecode is intended to limit decoder duplication, but buffering, compound-gate selection and sizing determine mapped area. Compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap is unverified. No EDA tools were available here; complete source and mapped equivalence proofs and zero reported max-slew/max-capacitance violations have not been obtained. This candidate is therefore not a certified passing result.",
  "functional_boundaries": "The module interface is preserved. For two-state inputs, exactly one enable is asserted: enable[0] for sel=0 or 10..15, and enable[n] for sel=n with n=1..9. Thus every output bit equals the specified selected input bit for all 84 unconstrained input bits. There is no clock, state, latency, latch, assumption or don't-care. Four-state X/Z behavior is not claimed equivalent. This reasoning is not a substitute for the required formal proofs."
}
